title: Michael G
content: My parents were taking us to a friend’s house for the 4th of July weekend. There were several other kids, but I was the only one who couldn’t swim. All of us jumped into the pool. Although the pool was only four feet deep, I went under the water. I don’t remember going under. What I do remember is flying through a tunnel made of swirling blue and silver beams. I was moving toward a very bright, white light. Yet, I did not feel like I was moving. I went into the light. The next thing I saw was a very large tree on a hill. The tree was surrounded by a valley with other hills and within walking distance. There were white houses with no features on them; they were standing in clusters of three on each hillside. In the valley, between the hills and surrounding the hill with the tree, were flowers everywhere. Each flower was either purple, blue, yellow, or orange. A creek ran down one side with a small stone, walking bridge crossing it. Above the bridge was a permanent sunset, giving the air a golden hue and filling everything with a strange, warm, and loving feeling. The next thing I knew, a group of kids and some young adults ran up to show me their spot under the tree. It had a campfire and a few stools. The walk up felt like it took a day. When we got there, a young woman with black hair was waiting for us. For no apparent reason, we all started laughing and goofing off. Everyone had big, joyful smiles. Then the woman led me to the edge of the hill, facing the sun, and had me sit down to watch. She said, "The best part is almost here." But just as the sun looked like it might set, I heard and felt a booming, yet calming, voice surrounding me say, "It’s not time for you yet." And I closed my eyes. When I opened my eyes again, I was being loaded into an ambulance and wracked with terrible pain. I couldn’t move, so I started crying. A shocked EMT shouted, "He’s alive!" One hour and forty-five minutes had passed since I went under the water.

environment.environment_other_detail: Large tree on a hill; valley with other hills; clusters of three white featureless houses on each hillside; many flowers (purple, blue, yellow, orange); a creek with a small stone walking bridge; “permanent sunset” with golden hue.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drowning/near-drowning in a pool (couldn’t swim; went under water).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encountered a group of kids/young adults and a young woman; heard a booming voice: “It’s not time for you yet.”
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel with bright white light, then entry into the light and arrival in a landscape; later a verbal message triggered return to the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: “Permanent sunset” over a landscape with clusters of three white featureless houses; the walk up to the tree “felt like it took a day.”
